coordinates.up: Y in BVH; output second coordinate is original world Y
coordinates.forward: Per-frame horizontal normalized b_Hips to b_Spine3
coordinates.units: Source units unchanged. Approximately centimeters inferred from 55-unit hip height, not an explicit dataset unit declaration.

conversion.rotationOrder: Zrotation Xrotation Yrotation, degrees; intrinsic matrix Rz*Rx*Ry
conversion.translation: Each declared position channel REPLACES that local offset component; no OFFSET + position duplication. Source repeats offsets in position channels.
conversion.filters: None in exported joint data. Source frames selected using endpoint pose+tangent similarity; see provenance.json. No resampling or averaging of exported values.
conversion.loopCorrection: None. Last sample retained independently. It is not numerically equal to first.
conversion.rootMotion: Signed cumulative hip movement projected onto mean consecutive horizontal headings. No clamping.
conversion.excludedNodes: Bip01_Footsteps, all Dog_*Armor*, Dog_LeftTail*, and terminal *Nub/End nodes. Their visual/helper semantics are not reliable anatomic contacts.

licenseStatus.figshare: CC BY 4.0, explicitly assigned to the dataset by the publisher record and API.
licenseStatus.github: README also says code and data are for research purpose only. LICENSE.txt describes MIT for software. These statements are not conflated.
licenseStatus.currentScope: Local research prototype. No deployment authorized.
licenseStatus.attribution: Motion source: Lei Han et al. (2024), Lifelike Agility and Play in Quadrupedal Robots using Reinforcement Learning and Generative Pre-trained Models, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24968946.v1, CC BY 4.0. Changes: selected frames, evaluated BVH hierarchy, projected selected joints into 2D; no retiming or loop correction.
licenseStatus.publisherComparison: Publisher and GitHub full clip match exactly after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Final input is the publisher archive member.

contactEstimates.method: Heuristic only, NOT mocap ground-truth labels: local forward velocity < -45% root forward velocity and world height below halfway between foot 10th/90th-percentile height. No temporal smoothing/cleanup.
